meta.title: 七夕“压纹玫瑰”🌹详细拆解教学
meta.title_en: Valentine's Pressed Rose Latte Art, Fully Broken Down
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 压纹玫瑰教学

scenes.title_en: The Base: Low Pour, Small Flow
scenes.context: 画椭圆搅拌式融合，低流距小流量注入，注入点在杯底距液面最高点位，避免砸出气泡。
sentences: 今天给大家详细拆解压纹玫瑰的制作方法。
Today I'll fully break down how to make the pressed rose.
break down（拆解）
融合时的手法：低流距、小流量注入。
For the base, pour low and keep the flow small.
low pour（低流距）
注入点在杯底距液面最高的点位，避免砸出气泡。
Inject at the highest point from the cup bottom, so you don't punch in bubbles.
punch in bubbles（砸出气泡）
paraphrase: 'The surface' — here it means the milk's surface.
Low and slow keeps the crema clean.
scenes.speak: Today I'll fully break down how to make the pressed rose. For the base, pour low and keep the flow small. Inject at the highest point from the cup bottom, so you don't punch in bubbles.

scenes.title_en: The Swirl: Stay Inside the Surface
scenes.context: 牛奶进入液面瞬间拉高流距画椭圆搅拌，轨迹必须在液面内，不碰杯壁防液面变脏。
sentences: 牛奶进入液面的瞬间，迅速拉高流距。
The instant milk hits the surface, raise the pour height fast.
raise the pour（拉高流距）
开始画椭圆搅拌。
Start the elliptical swirl.
elliptical swirl（椭圆搅拌）
轨迹一定要在液面里，不要碰到杯壁。
Keep the path inside the surface — never touch the cup wall.
cup wall（杯壁）
paraphrase: Touching the wall dirties the canvas you're drawing on.
Your swirl path is the whole game here.
scenes.speak: The instant milk hits the surface, raise the pour height fast. Start the elliptical swirl. Keep the path inside the surface — never touch the cup wall.

scenes.context: 融合到四分满，注入点位在液面中心偏上；持续增大流量边摆动边回杯，纹路半圆时缸子前推两厘米形成深V底纹；二段更大流量让底纹回包。
sentences: 融合到四分满，用钢嘴找到注入点位。
Blend to a quarter full, then find the pour point with the spout.
spout（钢嘴）
持续增大流量，边摆动边回杯。
Grow the flow steadily, swaying while you ease back.
ease back（回杯）
纹路形成半圆时，缸子往前推进两厘米。
When the pattern forms a half-moon, push the pitcher forward two centimeters.
half-moon（半圆）
二段注入流量更大，让底纹充分回包。
The second pour runs bigger, so the base wraps fully over the pattern.
wrap over（回包）
paraphrase: A deep V base takes shape.
The wider flow tucks the design inside the base.
scenes.speak: Blend to a quarter full, then find the pour point with the spout. Grow the flow steadily, swaying while you ease back. When the pattern forms a half-moon, push the pitcher forward two centimeters. The second pour runs bigger, so the base wraps fully over the pattern.

scenes.context: 底纹最高点偏中心用钢嘴画竖八字，贴近液面速度快；然后像包心一样左右交替推花瓣，花蕊加大流量完全包裹。
sentences: 钢嘴一定要非常贴近液面，并且速度要快。
The spout must hug the surface, and you have to move fast.
hug the surface（贴近液面）
从八字的中心开始注入，往上再往下。
Start pouring at the center of the eight, then up and down.
the eight（八字）
左边推一颗花瓣，右边推一颗花瓣。
Push a petal on the left, then a petal on the right.
petal（花瓣）
最后一颗花蕊加大流量，完全包裹在花瓣里。
Finish with a bigger flow on the center, fully wrapped in petals.
center（花蕊）
paraphrase: Too-wet foam won't stay unless the spout is close.
The same rhythm as wrapping a heart — left, right, left, right.
scenes.speak: The spout must hug the surface, and you have to move fast. Start pouring at the center of the eight, then up and down. Push a petal on the left, then a petal on the right. Finish with a bigger flow on the center, fully wrapped in petals.

practice.q: 「低流距、小流量注入」英文怎么说？
practice.a: Pour low and keep the flow small.

practice.q: 「纹路形成半圆时缸子前推两厘米」怎么翻译？
practice.a: When the pattern forms a half-moon, push the pitcher forward two centimeters.

practice.q: 「钢嘴贴近液面，速度要快」怎么说？
practice.a: The spout must hug the surface, and you have to move fast.

pitfalls: Pour with a big flow during the base.
Pour low and small, at the highest point of the cup bottom.
A heavy early pour punches bubbles into the crema before the surface is ready.
Let the swirl wander to the cup wall.
Keep the ellipse strictly inside the surface.
Hitting the wall dirties the surface and ruins the clean lines.
Keep the spout far from the surface at the end.
Hug the surface and move fast on the final eight.
With wet foam, the milk can't hold on the surface unless the spout is close.
Pause or cut the flow while pushing petals.
Keep a steady flow from petal to petal and finish with a bigger center.
Breaking the flow mid-petal makes the wrap incomplete and uneven.
shifts: 以前融合流量大、轨迹碰杯壁、收尾离液面远
现在控住流量节奏与液面轨迹：小流量防气泡、轨迹在液面内、贴面快画、连续推瓣

Find the pour point with the spout.

Push a petal on the left.
